text:
sam: Heads-up — I'm seeing a p95 jump on a handful of routes after we merged cohort buckets for the SLO rollup. When I toggle origin-by-client_tag the p95 snaps back. Anybody run into this before?

ira: Yep, I noticed earlier today on eu-region. Merge looks like it combines client_tag buckets which can skew percentiles when one client is heavy-tailed.

maia: Are we sure the merge mode we use for rollouts is correct? UI default is 'cohort-merge' which collapses client_tag by design vs keeping it as a dimension.

sam: What's the runtime cost if we preserve client_tag by default for rollouts? Users will probably want stable SLOs.

tj: Quick repro on the metrics side: we emit per-bucket tdigest sketches then do a GROUP BY route and tdigest_merge. If sample counts are very different the merged tdigest biases the pctl. Example query we used:
```
SELECT route, tdigest_quantile(tdigest_merge(sketch), 0.95) as p95
FROM metrics_buckets
WHERE window = '5m'
GROUP BY route
```

ira: The implementation detail: our merge dropped the sample_count tag when normalizing sketch records earlier in the pipeline. tdigest_merge requires proper weights; without them a big client dominates shape incorrectly.

maia: Proposal: (1) add a small annotation in the rollout UX — "Preserve client_tag during metric rollups" with explanation, default off; (2) pipeline change to carry sample_count through normalization; (3) document expected p50/p95 behavior in console docs.

sam: Sounds reasonable. Can we hotfix the pipeline to preserve sample_count as a short-term mitigation?

tj: I'll open a PR for the metrics pipeline: keep sample_count on the sketch envelope and switch merge policy to prefer 'preserve_by_tag' for active rollouts when client_tag is present. Rough patch already locally.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: metrics-pipeline v2.14 -> staging at 03:40UTC (canary enabled) :rocket:

maia: :thumbsup: Also can we add a tiny dashboard tile showing per-client p95 for the top 10 clients on the route? would help detect regressions quickly.

ira: On it. I'll add a tile + an alert: if top client p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.5 for 5m then fire.

sam: Thanks all. Follow-ups: tj -> PR #4522 for pipeline weight preservation, maia -> dashboard tile, ira -> alert rule. I'll track in rollout ticket RW-889 and include a short blurb in the console release notes.

tj: PR opened, marking as WIP. will request review from @ira and @maia.

maia: I'll draft the UI annotation copy: "Preserving client_tag prevents cross-client percentile blending during SLO rollups; may increase cardinality."

ira: One more note: we should add integration test that simulates heavy-tailed client merges so this doesn't regress.

sam: Agreed. thanks everyone.
